shots.narration_english: That night Rafhaan sat alone in the office going through the bank reports. He noticed the cheques had been cashed during office hours, at a time when Layaali never left the office.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އަހްނާ ރޭވި ރޭވުމެއްކަމުގެ ޝައްކު ރަފްހާންގެ ހިތަށް އަރަމުން ދިޔައެވެ. އޭނާ އަމިއްލައަށް ބޭންކުގެ ސީސީޓީވީ ފުޓޭޖް ހޯދަން ނިންމިއެވެ.
shots.narration_english: The suspicion that this was Ahna's plan grew in Rafhaan's heart. He decided to get the bank's CCTV footage himself.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ނަމަވެސް ޖެހިގެން އައި ދުވަހު ކަންތައްތައް މުޅިން އެހެން ދިމާލަކަށް އެނބުރުނެވެ. އަހްނާގެ ބައްޕަ އަޙްމަދު ޒާހިރު ރަފްހާންގެ އޮފީހަށް އައެވެ.
shots.narration_english: But the next day things took a completely different turn. Ahna's father, Ahmed Zaahir, came to Rafhaan's office.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އޭނާ އައީ ރަފްހާންގެ މަންމަ ޚަދީޖާ ގޮވައިގެންނެވެ. "ރަފްހާން!" ޒާހިރު ހަރުކަށިކަމާއެކު ބުންޏެވެ. "އަހްނާ ބުނި ތި އޮފީހުގެ އާދައިގެ ކުއްޖަކު ކުންފުނީގެ ފައިސާ ވަގަށް ނެގި ވާހަކަ.
shots.narration_english: He came bringing Rafhaan's mother Khadeeja with him. 'Rafhaan!' Zaahir said harshly. 'Ahna told me about an ordinary girl in your office stealing the company's money.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އަދިވެސް އޭނާގެ މައްސަލަ ޕޮލިހަށް ނުފޮނުވާ ލަސްކުރަނީ ކީއްވެ؟ އަހަރެންގެ އިންވެސްޓްމަންޓްތައް ތިފަދަ ތަނެއްގައި ބަހައްޓާކަށް އަހަރެން ބޭނުމެއް ނޫން.
shots.narration_english: Why are you still delaying sending her case to the police? I don't want to keep my investments in a place like this.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އަހަރެން ބޭނުންވަނީ ވީހާވެސް އަވަހަކަށް ތި ދެކުދީންގެ ކައިވެނި ކުރެވި އަހަރެންގެ ޝެއަރ އަހްނާގެ ނަމަށް ބަދަލުކުރާން."
shots.narration_english: I want the two of you married as soon as possible and my shares transferred to Ahna's name.'

shots.narration_english: Khadeeja pressed him too. 'Rafhaan, agree to the marriage. Otherwise this company can't be saved.' Rafhaan lowered his head.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އޭނާގެ ވަށައިގެން މަޅިތައް ވަނީ ގަތާފައެވެ. އަދި ލަޔާލީ ސަލާމަތްކުރާނީ ކިހިނެއް ހެއްޔެވެ؟ ދެ ޢާއިލާގެ ސަބަބުން އޭނާގެ އަމިއްލަ ހިތުގެ މިނިވަންކަން ހޯދާނީ ކިހިނެއް ހެއްޔެވެ؟
shots.narration_english: Traps had closed in around him. And how would he save Layaali? Caught between two families, how would he win his own heart's freedom?

shots.narration_english: Everyone was trying to save the business, and to bring Ahna into his life to keep it that way.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ރީތިކަމާއި ބޮޑާކަން ލިބިފައިވާ އަހްނާ އަކީ ރަފްހާންގެ އައިޑިއަލް އެއް ނޫނެވެ.
shots.narration_english: Ahna, with all her beauty and pride, was not Rafhaan's ideal.
